finding.fix: Invoke captured ArrayBuffer.prototype.byteLength getter as an intrinsic brand check before source copy; convert rejection to FINITE_VISCO_HISTORY_INVALID_INPUT.
finding.after: Spoofed shared buffer refuses; caller bytes remain unchanged. Ordinary ArrayBuffer subview preserves byteOffset, exact source length/hash and caller bytes. Own byteLength accessors are not invoked.
